title: S31 — reader integration: word-context crops + lexicon path over glyphcnn-v7b
desc: Evidence from S30/PR #67: v7b beats v4 on every measured distribution (corpus val 0.43->0.80 per-severity, easy solo glyph 0.90->0.92, easy raw-chain exact 19->31) but read-level hard exact barely moves (6->7) because the raw CNN chain has no lexicon and the floor feeds tight solo pieces. Two integration levers, measured separately: (1) word-context cropping at read time — cut floor pieces with +-1-2px neighbour context so the net sees its training distribution (v7 word-only val 0.79 vs v7 solo 0.70 proves the delta); (2) lexicon/projection path over v7b opinions (reader_lex already proves lex value on the template side: 73/23). Bar: beat shipping reader_lex+R5+S25 (73/23) on canonical easy/hard 3x, no easy regression, demo <=10s. Held-out protocol binding. Depends on PR #67 merge for weights.
